blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines – The House of Representatives on Tuesday rejected a motion to reconsider the P7.2-trillion spending bill that the chamber passed nearly a month ago, turning down a proposal that would’ve recalled the budget measure back to the House. House lawmakers rejected in a voice vote Bagong Henerasyon Rep. Robert Nazal’s motion to rescind the spending bill to address potential flaws that could afflict the 2027 budget, particularly its unprogrammed funding provisions that critics say is vulnerable to legal challenge.
